p: mighty: He exhorts the proud tyrants to humble themselves under God's hand, and not to be inferior to brute beasts and dumb creatures.
voice of the LORD is upon: The thunder claps that are heard out of the clouds should make the wicked tremble for fear of God's anger.
voice of the LORD breaketh the: That is, the thunderbolt breaks the most strong trees, and will men think their power able to resist God?
Sirion like a young unicorn: Called also Hermon.
flames of fire: It causes the lightnings to shoot and glide.
Kadesh: In places most desolate, where it seems there is no presence of God.
calve: For fear makes them deliver their calves.
discovereth the forests: Makes the trees bare, or pierces the most secret places.
temple doth every one speak of: Though the wicked are not moved by these lights, yet the faithful praise God.
flood: To moderate the rage of the tempests and waters that they not destroy all.
